notes: Integration/'connect X to Y' guides — the Zapier/Make programmatic-SEO pattern. Each article should cover: (1) a native/built-in option if one exists, (2) Zapier or Make as the no-code route, (3) a raw API/webhook approach for developers. Verify each tool's actual integration capabilities before writing — don't assume a native integration exists; several of these pairs (e.g. Stripe+Airtable) have none, and that's fine to say. Keep it factually accurate over padding length.
